title: kith-tui main.rs fetch_session failure exits without terminal cleanup
description: main.rs line 51: fetch_session is called with ? operator AFTER entering raw mode (line 42) and alternate screen (line 43). If fetch_session returns Err, the ? operator propagates it to main which returns Err. The cleanup block at lines 66-68 runs because it is after the result? call — wait, no: line 70 is 'result?' which means cleanup at lines 66-68 runs BEFORE result?. Let me re-read: lines 55-63 run, then cleanup at 66-68, then result?. Actually the code is: run() returns result, then lines 66-68 cleanup, then result? propagates. But fetch_session at line 51 is BEFORE run() and uses ? directly. If fetch_session fails, the ? at line 51 returns early from main without running lines 66-68 cleanup. The terminal is left in raw mode with alternate screen active.
